versions.content: Use Case Specific Extension of Formula Language A use case specific extension is indicated in the meta model by a specialization of FormulaExpression . The semantics of the extension is specified in the context of this specialization as a fragment of an ANTLR [11] specification redefining the following Tokens: – ExtKeyword - this provides additional keywords similar to epsilon – ExtUnaryFuncName - this provides additional names for unary functions – ExtBinaryFuncName - this provides additional names for binary functions It is not possible to extend the formula language by additional operators.
